title: wheelgap --json report
description: The object printed by `wheelgap --json` from report_json() in src/wheelgap/cli.py. This schema does not cover `--list-targets --json` or the `{"error": ...}` object printed on input errors. It describes the output of the wheelgap version it ships with: later versions may add keys, so a saved copy can reject newer output.

version.description: The wheelgap version that produced this report.

sources.description: Labels of the inputs that were checked (lockfiles, requirements files, or package names).

targets.description: The platforms and Pythons that were checked. Each package's results, rejected and via keys are these labels.

label.description: Key used in results/rejected/via: the platform alone when one Python is checked, or 'PYTHON PLATFORM' when several are.

python.description: Python version, with a trailing t for free-threaded builds.

platform.description: Platform name such as linux-x86_64 or musl-aarch64.

packages.description: One entry per package that is installed on at least one target.

skipped.description: Packages that were not looked up (git, path, file, editable, private index, …).

ignored.description: Package names excluded by --ignore or ignore = [...] in [tool.wheelgap].

with_gaps.description: Packages whose results include source, missing or unknown.

per_target.description: Gap counts for every checked target, keyed by target label, with zeros for a target without gaps (including when only one target is checked). Present from the release after 0.8.0 on; older versions leave it out.

source.description: Packages that build from source on this target.

missing.description: Packages that can't install on this target.

unknown.description: Packages wheelgap couldn't check for this target.

name.description: Package name as written in the input.

version.description: Pinned or resolved version, if known.

error.description: Why the package is unknown, otherwise null.

results.description: Status for each target, keyed by that target's label.

rejected.description: Present with --explain: rejected wheels and reasons, keyed by target label, only for targets whose result is source or missing.

via.description: Present with --explain: dependency path that installs the package, keyed by target label, for the same targets as rejected (uv.lock). Empty object when the input has no graph.

bundled.description: Present with --pyodide-lock when this package is bundled on a Pyodide target: the version Pyodide ships.

bundled_version_differs.description: Present with bundled: true when Pyodide's version isn't the one pinned, or is outside the required range (it still counts as bundled). Always false for an unpinned requirement.
